Welcome to Improved Health!
Your go-to channel for effective, low-impact workouts designed for 'every' body. You'll find three levels of workouts—Gentle, Beginner, and Intermediate—so you can find the level that suits you best. Once you know your level, head to the playlists to explore a variety of workouts, including cardio, strength, stretching, and all-in-one routines—with options for both talking and no-talking formats.

As a Recreation Therapist, Group Fitness Instructor, and Senior Fitness Instructor, my mission is to create fun, safe, and manageable workouts that help you feel your best—physically and mentally.

💺 Love chair workouts?
I have a second channel dedicated entirely to them! Check out new chair workouts every Thursday on:
👉 youtube.com/@ImprovedHealthChairWorkouts
(Older chair workouts will still be available here too!)

Thanks for being here—I hope you enjoy the workouts, and I wish you improved health!
Jules
